query:
SELECT au.id, au.name, au.email, au.tokenBalance,
       tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt as txDate
FROM app_users au
JOIN token_transactions tt ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.createdAt >= '2026-03-17'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC;
